title: NSClient V3, AAPS Full, Client1 and Client2; APS Mode can't be set via Client; all AAPS 3.3.3.0 -dev b
body:
Trying to set APS Mode via AAPS Client 1 or 2 3.3.3.0 - dev b wont' have any effect on Master.
Changing APS Mode on Master, will be reflected in the Clients though.

comments.body: OpenAPS up an running, APS shows Loop paused and can't be set to continue
do you have enabled accepting such treatments in sync options?

No, I didn't check for new sync options. It works now. 
Has "Disconnecting Pumpt" not been added for safety reasons? Cause Disconnecting Pump during high intense exercises might sometimes be the way to go.

I've noticed you can disconnect pump in AAPS; and in AAPSClient it then shows that the pump is disconnected. In AAPSClient you then can see the button to reconnect pump. Hitting it doesn't trigger any action in AAPS; pump stays disconnected. Is this a bug @MilosKozak ? 

It would be super-nice if it was possible to control if pump is connected/disconnected from AAPSClient, especially with Dash.
disconnection is not possible at the moment because it requires pump action (zero tbr)

Since the Pump can already be disconnected via SMS command. It would already be an improvement, if you can initiate the sms command via a button in AAPS Client UI. It has to be authenticated, before it comes into effect, but that would be ok.

Mushroom, implemented such a combination of SMS and AAPSClient APP in his sms_bolus, which I use. I can trigger sms for a simple bolus or even the boluscalulator via the Client and have the treatments recorded as well. Love it.

Just my thoughts. I am grateful for what you are doing anyway.
